expectations.name: contactor_weld_engages_on_k4_open
expectations.detail: dut:current_present not observed within 5s after relay_edge (seq 2) [BLOCKED: The fault DOES fire on the K4-open edge (verified: FAULT_FIRED {welded_contactor} at the same sim-time as the RELAY_EDGE {K4, open}), but its effect is invisible to a `dut: current_present` clause, and that is a property of the REAL firmware being mirrored, not of this file. WELDED_K4_CURRENT_ PERSIST deliberately bypasses the duty/current_a path and drives the CT channel's wave synth directly (sim_engine.c's own comment at that call site: 'wave_owner.c only reads snap.zones[ch].current_a while a channel is in MODEL mode ... amps read through regardless of what duty/current_a say underneath'); virtual_simfw.c ports that verbatim. Telemetry's per-zone i_amps field is snap.zones[].current_a -- the MODEL value -- which K4 gates to zero the moment it opens. On real hardware the DUT would see the persisted current through its own CT ADC reading the synthesized waveform; this fixture has no CT waveform and no DUT ADC, so nothing observable carries it. Confirmed by reading sim_engine.c/telemetry.c/virtual_simfw.c, not inferred from the FAIL.]

blocked_on.reason: The fault DOES fire on the K4-open edge (verified: FAULT_FIRED {welded_contactor} at the same sim-time as the RELAY_EDGE {K4, open}), but its effect is invisible to a `dut: current_present` clause, and that is a property of the REAL firmware being mirrored, not of this file. WELDED_K4_CURRENT_ PERSIST deliberately bypasses the duty/current_a path and drives the CT channel's wave synth directly (sim_engine.c's own comment at that call site: 'wave_owner.c only reads snap.zones[ch].current_a while a channel is in MODEL mode ... amps read through regardless of what duty/current_a say underneath'); virtual_simfw.c ports that verbatim. Telemetry's per-zone i_amps field is snap.zones[].current_a -- the MODEL value -- which K4 gates to zero the moment it opens. On real hardware the DUT would see the persisted current through its own CT ADC reading the synthesized waveform; this fixture has no CT waveform and no DUT ADC, so nothing observable carries it. Confirmed by reading sim_engine.c/telemetry.c/virtual_simfw.c, not inferred from the FAIL.
blocked_on.phase: No SaftyFW phase -- this is a fixture-observability gap. Closing it means either giving virtual_simfw a CT-amps read the harness can poll (a real SimFW command exists for the CT group; nothing in kilnsim's `dut: current_present` mapping consults it), or accepting that the persisted-current half of S9 is bench-only. Either way it is not something this scenario file can express.
